claim_boundary: Runtime evidence characterizes one recorded machine and software snapshot. It is not a universal speed or correctness claim, and ngspice is not treated as an exact physical oracle.

dense.description: Deterministic dependency-free baseline using BAB-CS dense linear algebra.

scipy.description: Explicit SciPy sparse profile with dependency versions and paths retained in the environment evidence.

hybrid.description: Per-case hybrid profile that uses dense algebra below 18 declared MNA unknowns and explicit SciPy sparse algebra at or above the reviewed crossover.

active_heun_deferred4_smooth.description: Active bounded Heun candidate for smooth linear and coupled-linear transients, with an implicit trapezoidal reference at least every four accepted steps and periodic replay every 16 accepted steps.

active_ab2_deferred4_events.description: Active bounded Adams-Bashforth second-order candidate for scheduled switching, with event boundaries handled by implicit authority and a reference interval of four accepted non-event steps.

active_ab2_reference1_nonlinear.description: Conservative active bounded Adams-Bashforth second-order candidate with a trapezoidal reference every accepted step for nonlinear diode cases whose independent authority is not yet converged.

fixed_accuracy.description: Each tool independently selects the first qualifying maximum timestep in an ascending power-of-two refinement sweep and records its native solver work. Refined numerical authorities must be four times finer than their family's finest candidate timestep and must agree with a half-refined authority within the declared convergence cap.

families.title: Repeated resistor-capacitor charging bank
families.behavior: Identical independently loaded resistor-capacitor channels share one ideal step source, preserving each channel time constant as the channel count grows.

families.title: Grounded nearest-neighbor coupled resistor-capacitor network
families.behavior: Capacitor nodes are coupled through fixed nearest-neighbor resistors, each node has a fixed shunt path, and only the first node is directly driven. The shunts keep the modal time-constant envelope bounded while increasing size adds genuine coupled modes.

families.title: Grounded nearest-neighbor coupled resistor-inductor-capacitor network
families.behavior: Each node carries fixed shunt resistor, capacitor, and inductor branches while fixed nearest-neighbor resistors couple the nodes and only the first node is directly driven. Increasing size adds mixed energy-storage modes without changing component values or the simulation interval. This is a reduced-order numerical scaling experiment, not a production device model.

families.title: Repeated resistor-inductor current bank
families.behavior: Identical independently loaded resistor-inductor channels share one ideal step source, preserving each channel time constant as the channel count grows.

families.title: Repeated nonlinear diode resistor-capacitor bank
families.behavior: Identical diode-loaded resistor-capacitor channels share one sine source and retain the same nonlinear excitation as the channel count grows.

families.title: Repeated scheduled switched resistor-capacitor bank
families.behavior: Identical switched resistor-capacitor channels share one step source and one event schedule while retaining independent dynamic states.
